rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_DLL {
    meta:
        description = "Detects common Cobalt Strike beacon DLLs via strings and entropy"
        author = "SOC Team"
        reference = "https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0154/"
        tlp = "amber"
        maldoc_type = "DLL"
    strings:
        $a = "beacon.dll" fullword ascii
        $b = "CryptEncrypt" fullword ascii
        $c = "WSASocket" fullword ascii
        $d = { 60 00 6E 00 73 00 68 00 69 00 65 00 6C 00 64 00 } // "nshield"
        $e = { 8B 44 24 10 8D 4C 24 18 51 50 E8 ?? ?? ?? ?? } // common beacon shellcode stub
    condition:
        uint16(0) == 0x5A4D and filesize < 500KB and 3 of ($a, $b, $c) and $d and $e
}
